programme.title: Hunter x Hunter: The Last Mission [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: The Battle Olympia begins! Gon and team attend, but The Shadow puts a deadly end to the festivities!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: When Dr. Eggman learns that Knuckles has just discovered the oldest map in the world, which holds the location of the lost continent of Murasia, he sends Decoe and Bocoe on a mission to take the map away from Knuckles.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic and his friends are in pursuit of Dr. Eggman, who has fled into the volcano which lies at the world's bellybutton. They come upon the Murasians ruin which attributed its destruction to a supposed dragon god.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: It seems Lord En isn't one to admit defeat quite so easily, as he challenges Furuichi and the rest to endless rematches. But it's not long until Furuichi and Lamia discover the whereabouts of Lord En, and it's only a matter of time until a fight breaks out! Will Oga's training be enough? And can Aoi get back in time?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Behemoth's Pillar Division has come in force, and the only thing that can stop them is the newly trained Oga! But the technique he's learned is so powerful, it risks the life of the user itself! It's a life or death gambit!

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. He coldly informs her that he will kill everyone in the country. However, Shion begs Shishigami not to leave her behind. Shion cries as she tells Shishigami that the people he's killed had futures and loved ones, and Shishigami makes a proposition.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. After taking them to safety, he wishes Shion a happy life. One day, Mari sees her father and Ando together. She follows after and sees Inuyashiki fly off into the sky. That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: A sinister voice rings out from the shell of Al's armor, and Ed and Greed find themselves under attack. As the Homunculi use the darkness to their advantage, a face from the past arrives to join the battle.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: After investigating the twisted roots of the Bradley family tree, Mustang gathers his most loyal troops. Meanwhile, Ed and his allies continue fighting Selim, who shocks everyone by turning on his own kind.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid's next target is Green Dream, the world's largest emerald and a one-time-only stage prop for a local play. Though the venue is crawling with cops under Nakamori's command, will Kid be able to make off with Green Dream as well as make a young actress's dream come true?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid has a new phantom thief rival in town, who flew all the way from France: Chat Noir! The felonious feline challenges Kid to steal a cat's-eye ring which may have belonged to Marie Antoinette, but this time, tough security measures have also been imported from France.

programme.title: BLEACH the Movie 4: Hell Verse [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: Ichigo must travel into the depths of Hell to stop a group of vicious Sinners and save his younger sister Yuzu, unaware that his actions could bring Hell to the World of the Living.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter: The Last Mission [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: The Battle Olympia begins! Gon and team attend, but The Shadow puts a deadly end to the festivities!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Dr. Bickley discovers that Sonic's world and theirs were once one and the same. As the two world slowly completes its reunification, she realizes that the process would ultimately cause time to stop. The only solution? Send Sonic and everyone back home.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: As Chris spends his last day with Sonic while they prepare for their trip home, the President's army colonel decides to act on his own to capture Dr. Eggman.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: It's a New Year's special where the entire cast of Beelzebub acts out everyone's favorite ancient Chinese fable, Journey to the West! See the gang as Son Goku, Sanzou the monk, and everyone else in their quest to reach Tenjiku and obtain the sacred sutra! Or maybe just to eat takoyaki! Whatever!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: It's time to start the Pudding-Pudding Exercises!

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The day after the mass killings in Shinjuku, Shishigami begins dropping airplanes onto the city. After receiving word from Ando, Inuyashiki manages to stop a number of them from crashing. He then notices that Mari is trapped inside a burning building, but Shishigami appears and attacks him. Inuyashiki is desperately trying to make his way over to save Mari, but Shishigami is right on his heels.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Saving many lives in Shinjuku, Inuyashiki returns home to open up to his family about his robot body. His family accepts him, and they embrace. After losing both arms, Shishigami goes to Ando who condemns him and Shishigami disappears. Inuyashiki finds out a giant meteor is about to hit earth. With the whole world in chaos, Inuyashiki flys towards the meteor to protect his family.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: With his father's help, Al takes incredible steps to contain the monstrous Pride. As the sun begins to rise on the Promised Day, the youngest Elric listens while the Homunculus ponders his very human mother.

programme.desc: Mustang leads a ragtag assault force of hardy northern troops - and welcome faces from the past - against Central's defenses. Victory seems certain until the military's most horrifying secret is revealed.

programme.desc: Kid is pressured into teaming up with Nightmare, a masked criminal mastermind with a penchant for losing partners to police custody and sometimes death itself! Will Kid make a successful steal and survive the night?
